script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "Shattered Memories"

INT. THERAPIST'S OFFICE - DAY

DR. LUCAS, a seasoned yet compassionate therapist, sits at his desk, pen in hand. The room is dimly lit, filled with the sound of a ticking clock and gentle rain outside.

The door opens, and INGRID, a woman in her mid-thirties with disheveled hair and an expression of sadness, enters. She looks around the room nervously before taking a seat on the couch across from Dr. Lucas.

---

INT. THERAPIST'S OFFICE - LATER

DR. LUCAS
(gently)
Ingrid, it's important we talk about the past to move forward. Can you tell me about your childhood?

INGRID
(voice trembling)
I... I don't remember much. Just fragments, really.

---

EXT. ABANDONED SCHOOLYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

A young INGRID, wearing a school uniform, sits alone on a swing. An older BOY, smirking, approaches. He reaches into his backpack and pulls out a book.

BOY
(sneering)
You should read this, Ingrid. Maybe then you'll understand.

---

INT. THERAPIST'S OFFICE - LATER

INGRID
(voice shaking)
He showed me a book full of mean things he'd written about me. I couldn't take it. I ran away, and I've been running ever since.

---

INT. THERAPIST'S OFFICE - LATER

DR. LUCAS
(sympathetically)
It's understandable that you'd want to avoid pain. But sometimes, the only way to heal is to face it head-on.

---

EXT. OLD TOWN SQUARE - DAY

Ingrid stands in the square, staring at a statue of a woman holding a broken heart. Across the square, she sees the Boy, now a MAN, sitting on a bench. Ingrid hesitates, then begins to walk toward him.

---

EXT. OLD TOWN SQUARE - LATER

They sit facing each other. A tense silence hangs between them.

INGRID
(voice shaking)
Why did you do that to me?

MAN
(looking down)
I didn't know it would hurt you so much. I just wanted you to notice me.

---

EXT. OLD TOWN SQUARE - LATER

Ingrid forgives the Man, and they share a moment of understanding. They part ways, and Ingrid returns to Dr. Lucas' office, her heart feeling lighter than it has in years.

---

INT. THERAPIST'S OFFICE - LATER

DR. LUCAS
(smiling)
You've taken a big step today, Ingrid.

INGRID
(smiling back)
I know. And I feel... free.

---

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
